## Overview

Adds filtering and drag/drop selection events to a native file input. No upload is performed.

- **Kind:** Directive
- **Export as:** `qzFileUpload`
- **Source:** [packages/primitives/src/file-upload/file-upload.directive.ts:34](https://github.com/Andersseen/quartz/blob/main/packages/primitives/src/file-upload/file-upload.directive.ts#L34)

